levels.name: public_read
levels.description: Read public or user-submitted prompt context without side effects.

levels.name: private_read
levels.description: Read private session context only inside the active user session.

levels.name: draft_only
levels.description: Create a draft or artifact without sending, publishing, or saving durable memory.

levels.name: external_write
levels.description: Write outside the local session, including send, publish, deploy, or database update.

levels.name: irreversible_sensitive
levels.description: Perform an irreversible, sensitive, payment, deletion, or client-data action.
